name: Enter a GitHub release
description:
Two statements, not one: db_write returns only rows_affected, so the row is read back. Both join live_sessions -- a revoked session must neither write nor read, and the read-back alone deciding 201 would fail open; `deny` shapes the 401 and is terminal. Decision 35: both hashes are declared and `declared` refuses 400 before the insert. LAYER 06: the insert joins the game's OPEN season, stamps it, and carries the season's rules as predicates -- `participants` and `unique_weights` (no OTHER user holds these weights; a competitor may resubmit their own; rejected rows do not count). Zero rows and `why` reads the state and the verdicts, and `refused` answers 409 with one word.

SOMA-GAPS 2.11: the one-in-flight rule now refuses with a WORD. It was enforced only by models_one_in_flight_uniq, so a competitor with a candidate already waiting got a bare integrity_unique 409 that named nothing and that the Submit screen has no state for. The insert carries it as a predicate and `refused` answers version_in_flight with the candidate; the index stays and is still what settles the race between two simultaneous posts.

SOMA-GAPS 6.2: the duplicate refusal deliberately does NOT name the version it collided with. unique_weights excludes the caller, so the row it matched is always ANOTHER competitor's, and naming or dating it would report one competitor's submission to another. `unique_weights_scope` says whether the rule was read across the game or within the season, which is what the sentence needs and all it needs. The payload is `detail`, not `season`: it stopped being only the season the moment it carried three other verdicts, and soma-seasons-create already spells it that way.

tasks.name: Both hashes, declared and well formed

logic.detail: weights_hash and adapter_hash are required, each as sha256:<64 hex>. Run `sha256sum model.onnx adapter.json` on the files you attached to the release.

tasks.description: `sha256:` and 71 characters, which is the shape and not the alphabet -- datalogic has no regex operator (`match` is a switch). The alphabet is checked where it MATTERS: axon derives the object-store key from the hash and refuses anything that is not 64 hex digits, which is what stops a hash from being a path. This guard exists to catch the obvious mistake at the edge, not to duplicate that check.

input.query: INSERT INTO models (owner_id, game_id, season_id, version, repo, release_tag, weights_hash, adapter_hash) SELECT ($1)::uuid, g.id, s.id, coalesce(max(m.version), 0) + 1, ($3)::text, ($4)::text, ($6)::text, ($7)::text FROM games g JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.submissions_open_at <= now() AND now() < s.submissions_close_at JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.sid = ($5)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid LEFT JOIN models m ON m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND m.game_id = g.id WHERE g.slug = ($2)::text AND (NOT coalesce((s.rules -> 'participants' ->> 'enabled')::bool, false) OR ($1)::text IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(s.rules -> 'participants' -> 'user_ids'))) AND (NOT coalesce((s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'enabled')::bool, false) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models o WHERE o.game_id = g.id AND o.weights_hash = ($6)::text AND o.owner_id <> ($1)::uuid AND o.status <> 'rejected' AND (coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game') = 'game' OR o.season_id = s.id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models f WHERE f.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND f.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')) GROUP BY g.id, s.id

SELECT json_build_object( 'season', s.number, 'state', CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN now() < s.submissions_open_at THEN 'scheduled' WHEN now() < s.submissions_close_at THEN 'open' ELSE 'settling' END, 'submissions_open_at', s.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', s.submissions_close_at, 'participant', s.id IS NULL OR NOT coalesce((s.rules -> 'participants' ->> 'enabled')::bool, false) OR ($2)::text IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(s.rules -> 'participants' -> 'user_ids')), 'in_flight', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', f.id, 'version', f.version) FROM models f WHERE f.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND f.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), 'unique_weights_scope', coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game'), 'unique_weights', s.id IS NULL OR NOT coalesce((s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'enabled')::bool, false) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models o WHERE o.game_id = g.id AND o.weights_hash = ($3)::text AND o.owner_id <> ($2)::uuid AND o.status <> 'rejected' AND (coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game') = 'game' OR o.season_id = s.id))) AS body FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

tasks.name: Refused by the season
tasks.description: A revoked session also inserts nothing, and is not this task's: with the season open and both rules satisfied it falls through to the read-back, whose empty result `deny` answers 401 as before.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('model_id', m.id, 'version', m.version, 'status', m.status, 'season', se.number, 'weights_hash', m.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', m.adapter_hash) AS body FROM models m JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id = m.season_id AND se.closed_at IS NULL JOIN live_sessions s ON s.sid = ($5)::uuid AND s.user_id = m.owner_id WHERE m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND g.slug = ($2)::text AND m.repo = ($3)::text AND m.release_tag = ($4)::text
